findings.text: no case gives a labelled baseline a non-empty failure set, so a regression that compared every label's after arm against one label's baseline would still pass all four tests; a UNIT baseline naming a failure its VALIDATION after arm also names would be the negative control for the central claim.

the labelled branch returns before _arm_missing_fields runs, so a labelled arm recorded at a revision behind the run head, or carrying a different suite command, is accepted as evidence where the unlabelled path would refuse it; the manifest documents this limitation, and closing it is a follow-up rather than a repair to this node.

labelled_suite_pairs duplicates the capability of reckon/crew/promotion_evidence.py:2123 _recorded_suite_pairs without extending it, and promotion_evidence._suite_pair_for_gate still reads only the unlabelled pair and the suite_pairs mapping, so a manifest armed with baseline_suite_<LABEL> arms is still unpaired there and one population's inherited failures can read as added.
_suite_arm_field_names restates the two prefixes that promotion_records.py:1513 already holds as _LABELLED_SUITE_PREFIXES, so a third spelling could be added in one place and silently not the other.

justifications.durability: tests/test_crew_merge_reads_labelled_suites.py:79 builds every labelled baseline with an empty failure_ids list, so all four cases pass even if every label's after arm were judged against one label's baseline — the cross-population laundering the fragment claims is prevented is not the thing any assertion would catch.
justifications.evidence: the gate the worker ran is tests/test_crew_merge_reads_labelled_suites.py recorded as "4 passed" with EXIT=0 in gate-head.log, and the negative control in negative-control-base.log reproduces "armed promotion requires complete baseline and after suite evidence; missing baseline_suite, after_suite" at ff3bb24bcf, which is the refusal the done_when says must appear at base; the gate log's header names the base revision because it ran pre-commit in the dirty worktree, and my re-run at 01b7af4e52 supplies the head-revision result the record lacks.
justifications.fit: the helpers follow the surrounding private-helper idiom of reckon/crew/promotion_records.py and the manifest module, carry no plan or ticket labels, and ruff check reports clean on the three staged files at head.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:1690 routes a manifest holding only labelled arms to the per-label evaluation, so the precise defect the section records (a passing labelled run refused for absent unlabelled fields) is what the change repairs.
justifications.reuse: the comparison itself reuses reckon/ledger.py's added_failure_ids and normalized_suite_observation, but reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:1516 re-implemented the "further suite pairs a manifest records" enumeration that reckon/crew/promotion_evidence.py:2123 _recorded_suite_pairs already owns, under a different manifest spelling, so the two readers now disagree about which pairs a manifest has.
justifications.scope_discipline: the four delivered paths all serve the section's deliverable and none touches plan state, pyproject or the figures tree, though reckon/crew/reports.py and reckon/crew/promotion_records.py lie outside the two paths the dispatch declared as expected.
